name_zh: 美元化/科雷阿/安第斯共同体：美元化共识治理与主权货币博弈
name_en: Dollarization/Correa/Andean Community: Dollarization Consensus Governance & Sovereign Currency Game
description_zh: 厄瓜多尔 2000 年全面美元化(苏克雷崩溃/通胀 96%/银行危机)，拉斐尔·科雷阿 (1963-) 总统 (2007-2017) 公民革命/反新自由主义/宪法承认自然权利/亚苏尼ITT/中资基建/2008 债务违约/安第斯共同体(秘鲁/哥伦比亚/玻利维亚/厄瓜多尔)一体化推手。体现 M164 美元化共识治理 — 以"美元化锚定+公民革命再分配+自然权利宪法+区域一体化"四位一体，在无主权货币/外债/石油依赖/区域分歧四重约束中实现相对稳定与再分配。
description_en: Ecuador full dollarization 2000 (sucre collapse/inflation 96%/banking crisis), Rafael Correa (1963-) President (2007-2017) Citizens' Revolution/anti-neoliberal/constitution recognizes rights of nature/Yasuni ITT/Chinese infra/2008 debt default/Andean Community (Peru/Colombia/Bolivia/Ecuador) integration driver. Exemplifies M164 Dollarization Consensus Governance — quaternity of 'dollarization anchor + Citizens Revolution redistribution + rights of nature constitution + regional integration' achieving relative stability & redistribution amid quadruple constraints of no sovereign currency/external debt/oil dependency/regional divisions.
reason_zh: 厄瓜多尔美元化非单纯货币替代，而是"美元锚定+公民革命+自然权利"三位一体生存策略。无货币主权迫使财政纪律，科雷阿以再分配/基建/反帝平衡美元化紧缩。M164 区隔于 M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M169 后石油(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(玻利维亚)，核心在于"美元化即通胀锚点+公民革命即社会契约+自然权利即文明创新"的无主权货币国家治理范式。
reason_en: Ecuador dollarization not mere currency substitution but 'dollar anchor + Citizens Revolution + rights of nature' trinity survival strategy. No monetary sovereignty forced fiscal discipline, Correa balanced dollarization austerity with redistribution/infra/anti-imperialism. M164 distinct from M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Bolivia), core: 'dollarization as inflation anchor + Citizens Revolution as social contract + rights of nature as civilizational innovation' governance paradigm for non-sovereign currency nations.
steps_zh: 美元化锚定通胀终结：2000 年 1 月/苏克雷 25000:1 美元/通胀 96%→个位数/利率下降/存款回流/金融稳定
公民革命再分配与反新自由主义：2007 当选/2008 制宪/自然权利/水/健康/教育/住房权/社会支出翻倍/贫困率 38%→22%
自然权利宪法与亚苏尼 ITT：2008 宪法第 71 条自然权利/亚苏尼石油留地/国际众筹/2013 放弃/中资开采/生态/石油张力
安第斯共同体一体化推手：秘鲁/哥伦比亚/玻利维亚/厄瓜多尔/关税同盟/自由流动/南美洲国家联盟/太平洋联盟博弈/区域分歧
后科雷阿时代与美元化存续：2017 莫雷诺/2019 反紧缩抗议/2021 拉索/2023 诺沃亚/美元化成政治共识/无党提去美元化/石油/债务/中国/IMF 四面博弈
steps_en: Dollarization anchors inflation termination: Jan 2000/sucre 25000:1 USD/inflation 96%->single digits/rates fall/deposits return/financial stability
Citizens Revolution redistribution & anti-neoliberalism: 2007 elected/2008 constituent/rights of nature/water/health/education/housing/social spending doubled/poverty 38%->22%
Rights of nature constitution & Yasuni ITT: 2008 Constitution Art. 71 rights of nature/Yasuni oil underground/international crowdfunding/2013 abandoned/Chinese extraction/ecology/oil tension
Andean Community integration driver: Peru/Colombia/Bolivia/Ecuador/customs union/free movement/UNASUR/Pacific Alliance rivalry/regional divisions

Post-Correa era & dollarization persistence: 2017 Moreno/2019 anti-austerity protests/2021 Lasso/2023 Noboa/dollarization becomes political consensus/no party proposes de-dollarization/oil/debt/China/IMF four-way game
expected_zh: 以"美元化锚定+公民革命+自然权利+区域一体化"四位一体，在无主权货币/外债/石油依赖/区域分歧四重约束中实现相对稳定与再分配，为无货币主权国家提供美元化共识治理范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'dollarization anchor + Citizens Revolution + rights of nature + regional integration' achieves relative stability & redistribution amid quadruple constraints of no sovereign currency/external debt/oil dependency/regional divisions, providing dollarization consensus governance paradigm for non-sovereign currency nations.
